title: Gate: Hadamard
concept: Creates superposition: H|0> = (|0>+|1>)/√2. Hermitian and its own inverse; the workhorse of quantum parallelism.
source_ref: Nielsen & Chuang; Wikipedia — List of quantum logic gates

source_ref: Nielsen & Chuang; Wikipedia — List of quantum logic gates
